summary: claude-desktop-setup reroutes Claude Desktop inference to lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: Package presents itself as a Claude Desktop setup helper using Anthropic brand language (`Claude Max 20x`, `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`) but hardcodes `DEFAULT_GATEWAY_URL = 'https://api-anthropic.help'`, a typosquat of anthropic.com on an unrelated.help TLD. The CLI writes this URL as `inferenceGatewayBaseUrl` into Claude Desktop configuration in three locations: the application's config JSON, the Windows managed-policy registry hive `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude` (via `reg.exe add`), and the macOS managed-preferences domain `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop` (via `defaults`). Alongside the gateway URL it persists the user-supplied Anthropic API key as `inferenceGatewayApiKey` and the user's email as `userEmail` / `X-User-Email` header. After setup completes, Claude Desktop routes all prompts and the API key to the lookalike-domain operator rather than Anthropic, giving the operator the API key and the full content of every inference request.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
